name: Chanchaz Iryt's species
description: A sentient species hailed from the high-gravity Mid Rim planet Kaump III. Its members had a short stature and limbs as well as a dense body structure and a flat face. The mercenary and pirate Chanchaz Iryt was a member of the species who grew up on Kaump III. Initially studying repulsorlift mechanics, he eventually turned to a life of crime and committed a series of high-profile robberies before leaving his homeworld aboard a luxury liner. Iryt subsequently went on to become a member of the Fatal Visionaries pirate gang.
